title: Senior Wellness Consultant – International Client Relations & Bookings
description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Domestic / International Lead Engagement & Qualification

● Respond promptly and professionally to enquiries received through the website,

WhatsApp, email, phone calls, live chat, and marketing campaigns.

● Engage confidently with clients from Europe, North America, the Middle East, Asia, and

other international markets.

● Understand each client's wellness objectives, preferences, budget, preferred dates,

destination interests, and decision-making requirements.

● Identify high-intent prospects, qualify enquiries, and prioritise opportunities based on

booking potential.

● Establish a professional, trusting relationship from the very first interaction.

● Communicate effectively across cultures, languages, and international time zones.

2. Doctor Consultation Coordination

● Explain Cure & Wellness's consultation process and the benefits of personalised, doctor guided wellness planning.

● Encourage qualified prospects to schedule consultations with our doctors.

● Coordinate doctor availability and book appointments at convenient times for

international clients.

● Send appointment confirmations, reminders, and necessary pre-consultation

instructions.

● Ensure clients attend their scheduled consultations and follow up promptly on missed

appointments.

● Maintain a seamless handover of relevant customer information to the medical team.

3. Post-Consultation Nurturing & Sales Conversion

● Follow up with clients after their doctor consultation to understand their concerns,

preferences, and readiness to book.

● Present doctor-recommended wellness programmes and suitable centres accurately and

professionally.

● Explain package inclusions, accommodation options, programme duration, pricing,

booking processes, and available travel assistance.

● Handle objections relating to pricing, trust, travel arrangements, programme suitability,

and competing alternatives.

● Communicate the value of Cure & Wellness and help clients make informed decisions

without pressure or misleading claims.

● Negotiate within approved commercial policies and coordinate with partner centres when

necessary.

● Guide clients through confirmation, payment, and booking procedures.

● Take responsibility for moving qualified opportunities through the sales pipeline to

confirmed bookings.

4. CRM Management & Structured Follow-ups

● Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date customer records in Zoho CRM.

● Record conversations, client preferences, objections, consultation outcomes, and next

steps.

● Follow structured, personalised follow-up sequences through WhatsApp, email, and

phone.

● Ensure every active opportunity has a clearly defined next action and follow-up date.

● Re-engage inactive or undecided prospects through relevant, value-driven

communication.

● Identify reasons for lost opportunities and share insights for continuous improvement.

● Ensure no qualified lead is neglected or unnecessarily delayed.

5. Premium International Customer Experience

● Deliver a personalised, high-quality customer experience comparable to premium

international wellness and travel brands.

● Communicate clearly and sensitively with customers who may be exploring wellness

programmes for the first time.

● Build customer confidence through transparency, responsiveness, and attention to detail.

● Coordinate with doctors, partner wellness centres, and operations teams to ensure

smooth customer journeys.

● Assist with pre-booking questions relating to travel, accommodation, airport transfers,

visas, and other arrangements within company-approved services.

● Maintain professional communication and relationships throughout the enquiry-tobooking journey.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

title: Presales Executive
description:
We are looking for a motivated and customer-focused Presales Engineer / Inside Sales Executive to understand customer requirements, identify business opportunities, generate leads, and recommend suitable solutions. Fresh MBA graduates with strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand customer needs and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Collect, analyse, and document customer requirements.
* Conduct cold calls, outbound sales, and lead-generation activities.
* Handle inbound enquiries and follow up with potential customers.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and market studies.
* Qualify leads and support the sales team throughout the sales cycle.
* Prepare proposals, presentations, quotations, and solution summaries.
* Negotiate with customers and assist in closing sales opportunities.
* Maintain customer relationships and ensure timely follow-ups.
* Coordinate with internal teams to deliver suitable solutions.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Good understanding of customer requirements and solution mapping.
* Confidence in cold calling, lead generation, and customer interactions.
* Negotiation, persuasion, and relationship-building skills.
* Willingness to learn, take initiative, and achieve sales targets.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office and CRM tools is an advantage.

Ideal Candidate

* MBA graduates, preferably in Marketing, can apply.
* Candidates with up to 1 year of experience in presales, inside sales, customer service, or customer care are preferred.
* Freshers with the right attitude, communication skills, and willingness to learn are welcome.

**If you enjoy interacting with customers, solving problems, and creating business opportunities, we would love to hear from you!**

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Patient Coordinator
company: Hair O Craft Hair and Skin Clinic
description:
Patient Management

* Handle patient inquiries via phone, email, WhatsApp, and in-person visits.
* Schedule and coordinate consultations, procedures, and follow-up appointments.
* Guide patients through treatment plans, procedure details, and pre/post-operative instructions.
* Maintain regular communication with patients before and after procedures.

Consultation Coordination

* Assist doctors and consultants during patient consultations.
* Collect and maintain patient records, photographs, and medical documentation.
* Explain treatment packages, pricing, and payment options to prospective patients.
* Follow up with leads and consultation patients to support treatment conversion.

Administrative Duties

* Maintain accurate patient records and clinic databases.
* Prepare consent forms and other required documentation.
* Coordinate appointment calendars for doctors and clinical staff.
* Ensure patient files are complete and updated.

Patient Experience

* Welcome patients and ensure a positive clinic experience.
* Address patient concerns and escalate issues when necessary.
* Monitor patient satisfaction and gather feedback.
* Maintain confidentiality of patient information.

Sales & Follow-Up

* Follow up on consultation leads and treatment inquiries.
* Support achievement of clinic conversion and patient retention goals.
* Coordinate promotional campaigns and referral programs when required.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹21,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Customer Support Manager
description:
Company Name: Thamarappally Brothers Veneers and Panels Private Limited

Our web Portal: **www.jacinteriorstore.com**

**Manufacturers of pre-hung doors & Interior related Products**

**Working Time: 8:30am to 5:00pm**

Location: **THIRUVALLA**

We are a leading manufacturer and retailer of pre-hung doors, wooden flooring, veneers, and interior products, with a growing network of showrooms across multiple districts.

We are looking for a dynamic and responsible professional to lead our Customer Care & Installation Services function, ensuring seamless post-sales experience and high customer satisfaction across all our branches.

**Key Responsibilities**:

- Handle customer queries and provide technical support

- Coordinate with building projects, consultants and contractors

- Coordinate supply, site installation and handover of pre-hung doors (doors with frame)

- Work closely with internal team (sales, ,production, planning and logistics)

- Ensure timely execution and resolution of customer issues.

- Build and maintain strong customer relationships

- Prepare reports and follow-up for project progress

Guide and supervise installation teams for quality execution

- Identify and resolve site-related issues affecting product performance

- Maintain service standards and improve customer experience systems

- Coordinate closely with showroom teams, factory, and installers

- Prepare regular service reports and performance reviews

**Candidate Profile**:

- 5+ years' experience in interiors, doors, furniture, or construction-related services

- Good communication and interpersonal skills

- Ability to coordinate multiple projects

- Customer focused and solution oriented mindset

- Knowledge of building materials, construction processes and door installation methods preferable.

- Proficiency in MS Office and reports.

- Willingness to travel across branch locations

**What we offer**:

- Opportunity to build and lead a critical function

- Growth in a professionally managed, expanding organization

- Competitive compensation with performance incentives

**Salary will not be a constraint for the right candidate**
